segments.text: Good evening. This is Aakashwani and I am Valsa Williams with the news at 9.
The headlines
Cabinet approves continuation of national social assistance program for five years,
revises eligibility criteria and assistance rates for disability pension beneficiaries.
Government gives nod to strategic restructuring of IDBI bank
and 78-day bonus for railway employees.
From Minister Narendra Modi reaffirms, India's commitment to building a forward-looking strategic
partnership with Canada both countries review progress in ties with focus on trade, energy
and security.
India calls attacks on civil infrastructure inside the Arabia unacceptable, urges immediate
cessation.

countries for each farmer before Diwali.

skating games in Paraguay and in men's cricket, fourth D-20 international between India and

The union cabinet has approved the continuation of the National Social Assistance Program
for five years from 2026-27 to 2030-31 with an outlay of 53,428 crore rupees.
Information and Broadcasting Minister Ashwini Vaishnav made the announcement
while briefing the media after the Union Cabinet meeting
chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi today.
The approval also includes renaming of the scheme and its sub-schemes
along with revisions to the eligibility criteria, coverage
and rates of assistance for disability pension beneficiaries.
The National Social Assistance Programme has been renamed
as Pradhan Mantri Samaajik Sahayata Yojna.
Mr. Vaishnav said the assistance under the disability pension scheme
will be 375 rupees for beneficiaries up to the age of 79 years
and 625 rupees for those aged 80 years and above.
He said the benchmark disability criterion for eligibility
disability will be reduced from 80% to 40%.
The eligibility threshold for disability pension
has been reduced from 80% to 40%. This means that persons
with disabilities with a 40% disability will now also be eligible
for the pension. Earlier disability pension was provided only to individuals
above the age of 18. Now persons with disabilities will be eligible
for the pension from birth. The number of beneficiaries is expected to
increase significantly, with approximately 27 lakh persons with disabilities expected
to benefit under this condition scheme, where total number of beneficiaries will rise to
around 3 crore-20 lakhs.
Pension schemes for senior citizens and widows as well as the family benefit scheme will
continue in their existing form.
The union minister said the government has also given the nod to the strategic restructuring
of IDBI Bank.
A decision has been taken to undertake the strategic restructuring of IDBI Bank.
As India continues to grow rapidly, there is a significant need for growth capital.
We need more institutions that can provide growth capital and support micro, small and
medium enterprises.
Therefore, a strategic partner has been selected for IDBI Bank.
With the support of this strategic partner, fresh capital will be infused into the
bank.
This decision has paved the way for what could be the largest FTI in India's financial
central service sector.
Mr. Vaishnav said the Cabinet has also cleared a productivity-linked bonus of 78 days for
more than 11,40,000 eligible railway employees in recognition of their performance.
The Cabinet today approved a productivity-linked bonus equivalent to 78 days wages for around
11,40,770 railway employees.
The bonus is a Diwali gift for all railway employees who work tirelessly day and night
to ensure the smooth functioning of the Indian railways.
The total financial outlet for the bonus is approximately Rs 2,009 crore.
From Minister Narendra Modi today, reaffirmed India's commitment to building
a constructive and forward-looking strategic partnership with Canada
aimed at delivering tangible benefits to the people of both countries.
Mr Modi met Canadian Foreign Minister Netaan and their New Delhi, and reviewed ongoing efforts
to strengthen bilateral relations.
During the meeting, the two sides discussed enhancing cooperation in key areas, including
trade, technology, security, energy, education, and people-to-people exchanges.
The Prime Minister emphasized the need to sustain the momentum in bilateral engagement
and translated into concrete outcomes, including the early conclusion of negotiations on
a comprehensive economic partnership agreement. Earlier in the day, the Canadian Foreign Minister
held talks with the external affairs minister Dr. S. Jai Shankar, and Minister of State
for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Jai and Singh, in the national capital.
India has strongly condemned the recent attacks on civilian infrastructure in Saudi Arabia,
briefing the media in New Delhi this afternoon. External affairs ministry spokesperson
person, Andhir Jaiswal, condemned the attack on the Aramco headquarters, which took place
in the West Asian country yesterday.
He described such acts as totally unacceptable and called for an immediate end to them.
There have been a string of attacks in Saudi Arabia and we have condemned those attacks.
Yesterday also there was an attack on Aramco headquarters.
We condemn all such attacks on civilian infrastructure in Saudi Arabia.
We feel that such attacks need to cease immediately.
they are totally unacceptable. We stand in solidarity with the people and government of
Saudi Arabia in defense of their sovereignty and we hope there is return to peace and normalcy
in the region soon.
Meanwhile, the Indian Embassy in Riyadh today urged all Indian nationals to continue to
follow local authorities' instructions, stay indoors in case of aerial attack, and refrain
from circulating videos or news related to ongoing events, in view of the current
situation in Saudi Arabia.
The central government has notified amendments to the India Mauritius Double Taxation Avoidance
Agreement introducing a principal purpose test to prevent the misuse of treaty provisions
for tax avoidance and evasion under the revised agreement.
Tax treaty benefits may be denied if obtaining such benefits is found to be one of the
principal purposes of a transaction or arrangement.
Welcome back here with us on the news at 9.
The government has constituted a committee to examine issues raised by sugarcane farmers
farmers and recommend appropriate measures for addressing their concerns.
Former member of Niti Ayog, Professor Ramesh Chand, will chair the panel.
The constitution of the committee follows the decision taken during a meeting of representatives
of sugarcane farmers from Karnataka and Maharashtra with the Union Minister of Agriculture and
Farmers' Welfare and the Union Minister of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution.
We have a report.
The Committee will examine the demand for an increase in remunerative returns to sugar
cane farmers taking into account cultivation costs and other relevant factors.
It will also examine the demand for revision of the X-mil minimum selling price of sugar
in the context of sugar production costs, market realizations and the financial viability
of sugar mills.
Other key areas of examination will include existing mechanisms for testing and reporting
supporting sugar recovery and prevailing sugarcane weightment practices at sugar mills with Anand
Kumar Rishu Jayaswal, Akashwani News, Delhi.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has said India's civilizational journey has been shaped by centuries
of cultural exchange and the sharing of knowledge across borders. Mr. Modi made
the remarks in a written message delivered at the inaugural session of the three-day
International Conference on Bharat's cultural connections across the globe in New Delhi today.
The Prime Minister's message was read out by Culture Secretary Vivek Agarwal at the
conference. Mr Modi highlighted the role of ancient centres of learning such as Nalanda
in promoting the exchange of knowledge between India and other parts of the world. Prime
Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined
and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasana,
the government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a vikasiddh Bharat by 2047.
Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives.
Today in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action
through initiatives like Pradhan Mantri Sangrahala.
Pradhan Mantri Sangrahala, inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2022, highlights
the contributions of all the prime ministers to the nation's development.
The museum showcases how Indian democracy has provided opportunities for leaders from
every section of society to contribute to nation-building.
Spread across two buildings, the modern digital museum offers visitors an insight
into India's political history, democratic traditions, and journey of development.
The Sangrahale features a light and sound show titled Viranganau Ki Mahagatha, which narrates
the inspiring stories of violent women warriors who fought to uphold the nation's pride.
Inaugurating the Pradhan Mantri Sangrahale, Prime Minister Narendra Modi described the
as a living symbol of the shared heritage and collective contributions of all governments.
During his visit to the Pradhan Mantri Sangrahal, Justice S. Turai Raja of Sri Lanka shared his
reflections on India's democratic journey and the leadership that has shaped the nation.
We came to Delhi on the invitation of the Chief Justice of India, and it's a surprise
call from the esteemed establishment to visit them, the people are very nice, the organizers
are superb, the directors and the cheerful children, those who are guiding us, and asked
us in a different level, and I don't feel like going, but wish to come back again.
Located at Tinmurti Marg in New Delhi, the Pradhan Mantri Sangrahale inspires the
younger generation by showcasing the vision, leadership and contributions of all the
Prime Ministers. Anand Kumar, Akashwani News, Delhi.

Speaking to reporters after a state cabinet meeting in Mumbai today, Chief Minister Devendra
Farnaves said each farmer in the affected areas will receive initial financial assistance
of Rs. 5,000 directly into their bank accounts before Diwali.
The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority and NPCI Beam Services Limited
have launched Tatkal NPS on the Bheem Payments app.
The new feature allows eligible citizens to open a national pension system account
in just three steps using existing bank verified KYC and UPI
eliminating the need for branch visits or fresh paperwork.
India's Anand Kumar Vail Kumar won a silver medal in the men's
1,000 meter sprint category at the World Skating Games
being held at Asuncion in Paraguay.
the Tamil Nadu skater missed out on a chance to win gold by a narrow margin of 4 milliseconds.
Earlier he won bronze in the 500-metre sprint.
In men's cricket, West Indies have set a target of 248 runs.
For hosts Inter and the 4th T20 international in Hyderabad,
earlier put into bat, West Indies boasted 247 runs for the loss of three wickets
in the stipulated 20 overs. In reply, Inter were 24 for no loss in
1.5 overs when reports last came in, the hosts are leading the five-match series to one after
defeating West Indies by 14 runs in the 30-20.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will interact with the Indian contingent that participated
in the Asian Games to 2026 in New Delhi tomorrow.
And now before we end the bulletin, the headlines once again.
